title: Coconut Sweet Venezuelan Pudding
description: A creamy and delicious dessert made with coconut milk and sweet Venezuelan pudding.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, combine coconut milk, pudding mix, and sweetened condensed milk. Whisk until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the mixture comes to a boil.
Remove from heat and stir in zesty lime juice.
Pour the mixture into individual serving cups or ramekins.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or until chilled.
Top with shredded coconut before serving.
